commands.name: list-categories
commands.summary: List GovInfo collection categories and the collections (code, slug) in each

commands.name: get-collection
commands.summary: Get metadata for a collection: title, description, help/RSS links and related resources

commands.name: browse-collection
commands.summary: List the top-level browse nodes of a collection (congresses for bills, years for the Federal Register) with document counts

commands.name: list-bill-types
commands.summary: List the bill types (hr, s, hres, hjres, hconres, ...) in a Congress, with counts

commands.name: list-bill-ranges
commands.summary: List the bill-number ranges (e.g. [0-99]) for one bill type in a Congress, with counts

commands.name: list-bills
commands.summary: List bill versions (package IDs, titles, publish dates, file links) in a bill-number range of a Congress and bill type

commands.name: list-fr-months
commands.summary: List the months of a Federal Register year, with document counts

commands.name: list-fr-issues
commands.summary: List the daily Federal Register issues in a month (issue labels like 'Friday, January 31, Pages 8625-8752') with whole-issue download links

commands.name: list-fr-issue-agencies
commands.summary: List the agencies that have documents in one daily Federal Register issue, with counts

commands.name: list-fr-agency-documents
commands.summary: List one agency's documents in a daily Federal Register issue (granule IDs, titles, sections, pages)

commands.name: get-fr-toc
commands.summary: Get the Federal Register table of contents for a date: every agency with its document subjects, pages and FR doc numbers

commands.name: get-content-details
commands.summary: Get details for a document (granule) or package: title, metadata table, download links (PDF/HTML/MODS/ZIP), citations and dates

commands.name: list-related-collections
commands.summary: List the kinds of related documents available for a granule (e.g. FR-DOCKETID: documents sharing a docket ID)

commands.name: list-related-documents
commands.summary: List documents related to a granule within a related collection, e.g. Federal Register documents sharing its docket ID

commands.name: get-document-in-context
commands.summary: Show where a granule sits in its package (issue/agency browse node) plus whole-issue download renditions

commands.name: list-government-authors
commands.summary: List government authors (agencies, courts, congressional bodies) grouped by executive, judicial and legislative branch

commands.name: browse-committee
commands.summary: List the publication collections (bills, reports, hearings, ...) available for a congressional committee

commands.name: browse-committee-collection
commands.summary: List the Congresses for which a committee has publications in one collection (e.g. hearings, reports, bills)

commands.name: get-document-html
commands.summary: Fetch the full text (HTML rendition) of a bill version or a Federal Register document

commands.name: get-package-mods
commands.summary: Get the MODS bibliographic metadata of a package (converted from XML to JSON): titles, names/sponsors, dates, identifiers, links
